notes: Read SKILL.md (243 lines) in full; it is the only file. The skill defines a bounded claim/extract/doubt/reconcile/stop loop in which the agent sends a stripped artifact plus contract to a fresh-context adversarial reviewer (a subagent) before non-trivial decisions stand, with at most three cycles.

Medium because it can (a) spawn subagents that override persona response shape (SKILL.md:110) and (b) on the user's choice, run external model CLIs (`codex exec --sandbox read-only`, `gemini --approval-mode plan`, SKILL.md:139-149) after `which`/`--version` checks, writing the prompt to a temp file (/tmp/doubt-prompt.md) and sending code to a third-party model service with the user's own CLI auth/API keys. Acceptable because every CLI run requires explicit per-invocation user confirmation (SKILL.md:130, :164, :205), never runs in non-interactive contexts, uses read-only sandbox modes, and pipes via stdin to avoid shell injection (:135).

Users should know cross-model review transmits the selected code/artifact to Google or OpenAI tooling. Pointers outside the skill are optional: `../../references/orchestration-patterns.md` (SKILL.md:46, :229) only cites the source of a rule that is stated inline, and the repo `agents/` personas (:108) have a stated generic-subagent fallback (:110). Sibling skills (code-review-and-quality, source-driven-development, test-driven-development, debugging-and-error-recovery) are optional cross-references.
